1. Page1 contains only the image and no text. Is that how it is meant to be? For the cover, will there be no text at all? How will it appear when printed?

3. The text says Published in India by "Being Mindful Parents". Will I be able to change this later?

- Chapter2
- Chapter4
- Managing the In-Laws
- For the Partner
5. In Chapter7, the image is cropped at the top right. Once I receive the correct size details, I can share this one as well.
6. I removed the full stop from the table text.
7. In Chapter12, the punctuation of the first line is different. Specifically, the first letter of every word is in Caps. In the previous revision, the first line appeared as a subtitle, while the following lines were body text starting on a new line and using normal punctuation. In this revision, both lines are at the same level, so the first line’s punctuation seems out of place.
8. I made a few minor text edits. They are available through track changes.
9. Could you advise me about the front and back matter content that is required? Is anything else necessary for publishing?
